title: Chinese Almond Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy Chinese stir fry with almonds and a sweet sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Serve over rice or noodles.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the eggplant and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sugar, and 2 tablespoons of water.
Pour the sauce over the eggplant and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the almonds and scallions, and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
